text:
jordan: kicking off deploy for llm-router v2.3.1 — enabling semaphore flag `llmroute_throttle` at 10% for prod cohorts. release notes: https://redwood.internal/release/llm-router-v2.3.1 :rocket:

deploy-bot: Automated: deploy started for service=llm-router, version=v2.3.1 by jordan. stages: canary -> gradual.

kim: holdpoint request — keep flag at 10% for 20m smoke window. gating metrics: p95 latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%, queue depth stable. will post results.

marco: pinned routing config in deploy manifest: `route.default_pin = \"model-v2.3\"` so traffic hitting the new route uses model-v2.3.1 shard.

jordan: ack @kim — starting canary now against internal-qa then prod 10%.

deploy-bot: Flag update: `llmroute_throttle` set -> 10% prod cohorts (internal-qa override 100%) by jordan.

kim: smoke update after 8m: embeddings and chat flows pass sanity. small latency bump: avg +12ms, p95 = 180ms, errors = 0.12%. :thumbsup:

elaine: heads-up — seeing a mild queue depth increase on router-pod gpu-4. @sre-oncall can you take a quick look?

sre-oncall: looking now. cpu on router pods spiked to 74% on pod gpu-4, no elevated 5xx. watching for next 10m. setting rollback triggers in runbook: p95 > 350ms OR error rate > 1% => immediate flag disable. disable command:```/deploybot flag disable llmroute_throttle``` or via Admin Console: https://redwood.internal/flags/llmroute_throttle

kim: if gates hold, plan to ramp to 40% at 10:25 UTC (10m from now).

deploy-bot: Scheduled action queued: ramp `llmroute_throttle` -> 40% at 10:25 UTC (manual approval required).

jordan: /approve ramp to 40% (manual ack).

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_throttle` -> 40% by jordan at 10:25 UTC.

marco: post-ramp metrics (5m): p95 = 210ms, errors = 0.2%, queue depth stabilized. minor perf cost but within budget. recommend proceed to broader rollout in next window.

elaine: adding note to release notes: "gradual enable of llmroute_throttle semaphore (10% -> 40%). Fallback policy: route to baseline model v2.2 if errors exceed threshold; rollback triggers in runbook. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/llmroute-rollback"

jordan: added final tag to release notes and pinned version in changelog. thanks everyone — will open a follow-up thread if we hit the next ramp. :white_check_mark:
